rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound: a-śaṅkitavya (not-to-be-doubted) + avaśyan-tā (necessity) + sattāka (having existence); describes naimittika rite's status in v4 of nitya/naimittika aporia (vv1-5)
compound: jātu-cid (ever, at any time) + bhavam (occurring, arising); qualifies the rite as arising on occasion, supporting naimittika definition
compound: pramātṛ (knower/agent) + niyatam (fixed, determined); indicates dependence on the practitioner's occasion/cognition in nitya/naimittika discussion
sandhi-split: prāhuḥ (they say, 3pl perfect) + naimittikam (occasional rite) + idam (this); states the naimittika designation announced in v1
nominative plural masculine of budha (wise one); subject of prāhuḥ, the authorities defining the rite
